item.title: College student fatally shot by police after knocking on wrong door
item.description: Glenn Pysher was trying to find his friends when he accidentally knocked on the door of the wrong house. The homeowners called 911 to report an attempted break-in.

item.title: Philadelphia's Chucky-style masked man arrested in Las Vegas
item.description: U.S. Marshals say 22-year-old Zymire Hughes was arrested Tuesday night in Las Vegas, Nevada.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham projected to win runoff in South Carolina GOP Senate primary
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham won the GOP Senate runoff in South Carolina on Tuesday night, CBS News projects, defeating Rep. Ralph Norman in the special primary to replace Graham's late brother, Sen. Lindsey Graham, on the ballot.

item.title: Dolly Parton: "The brighter I shine, the happier everybody is" | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: When 60 Minutes' Morley Safer spoke to Dolly Parton back in 2009, she showed off memorabilia from "9 to 5" along with dresses covered in rhinestones. "I used to be tall until I started wearing them," she joked.

item.title: Dolly Parton remembered by fellow stars, politicans: "A true loss for millions"
item.description: President Trump said that he would be "lowering the American flag" throughout the nation for one week in Dolly Parton's honor.

item.title: 3 Secret Service officials put on leave amid probe into "potential misconduct"
item.description: The Secret Service's chief of communications and two other staffers have been placed on leave pending an investigation into "potential misconduct," U.S. officials told CBS News.

item.title: Ross Fire explodes to over 50,000 acres, forces evacuations in North Texas
item.description: The Ross wildfire has burned more than 50,000 acres across Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forcing evacuations, closing roads and disrupting schools.

item.title: Darline Graham wins South Carolina GOP Senate primary runoff, CBS News projects | Special Report
item.description: Sen. Darline Graham, the late Lindsey Graham's sister, won the Republican Senate primary runoff in South Carolina on Tuesday night, CBS News projects. Jessi Mitchell anchors a special report.

item.title: Judge delays custody decision in surrogacy fight over newborn with heart defect
item.description: Dallas judge has delayed a custody decision, extending a temporary restraining order another two weeks as the legal fight over custody of a baby with a rare heart defect born to a surrogate continues.

item.title: Dolly Parton: Her music, personality and fan tributes
item.description: "CBS Evening News" pays tribute to the life and legacy of Dolly Parton. She died at 80 after a brief battle with cancer, her team announced on Tuesday.

item.title: President of Dolly Parton's foundation says nonprofit will "carry her dream forward"
item.description: Dolly Parton, who died Tuesday at age 80, leaves behind much more than a musical legacy. A generous philanthropist, she gave millions to a variety of causes, including education and children's literacy. Dollywood Foundation President Jeff Conyers joins CBS News to discuss the organization's Imagination Library program.

item.title: Attorney weighs in on Texas surrogacy dispute
item.description: A Texas judge is hearing arguments on who has the legal right to make medical decisions on behalf of a baby with a heart defect who was carried to term by a surrogate against the biological parents' wishes. Harry Nelson, a healthcare attorney, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

item.title: What to expect from key U.S. inflation indicator releasing Wednesday
item.description: The PCE price index report, which provides an overview of the current state of inflation across goods and services in the U.S., will be released on Wednesday morning. Jessica Inskip, director of investor research at Stockbrokers.com, joins "The Daily Report" to break down what to expect.

item.title: Dolly Parton on her life and road to stardom (2016)
item.description: From May 2016, Dolly Parton speaks with Gayle King about her road to country music fame, Whitney Houston's cover of "I Will Always Love You," her marriage and more.

item.title: British Columbia Premier says "America can't be trusted," claims relationship broken
item.description: David Eby, premier of British Columbia, tells "The Daily Report" he thinks the relationship between the U.S. and Canada will never go back to the way it was following President Trump's latest wave of tariffs.

item.title: Tony Dokoupil reflects on interviewing Dolly Parton in 2019
item.description: In 2019, "CBS Evening News" anchor Tony Dokoupil sat down with country music legend Dolly Parton for "CBS Sunday Morning." Dokoupil joins to remember the late singer-songwriter.

item.title: Dolly Parton, country music legend, dies at 80 after brief cancer battle
item.description: Dolly Parton became an icon over her six-decade career as a Grammy-winning singer-songwriter, movie and TV star and theme park owner who donated millions to help others.

item.title: Country Music Hall of Fame curator shares Dolly Parton memories
item.description: Allison Moorer, writer-editor for the Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum and curator of its current exhibit, "Dolly Parton: Journey of a Seeker," joins "The Daily Report" to share her favorite memories of Dolly Parton, who has died at age 80.

item.title: Results roll in as South Carolina holds runoff to replace Sen. Graham on ballot
item.description: Darline Graham, the Trump-endorsed sister of the late Sen. Lindsey Graham, is facing off against Rep. Ralph Norman in a runoff race for the GOP nomination for South Carolina's Senate seat.

item.title: Why Dolly Parton is so beloved
item.description: A 2026 YouGov poll for The Times found that Dolly Parton is the celebrity who best represents the American dream. Tony Dokoupil explores why.

item.title: College student shot by police after knocking on wrong door, investigation underway
item.description: The parents of a 22-year-old college student who was fatally shot by police after knocking on the wrong door spoke out on Tuesday. Tom Hanson has more details.

item.title: Canada announces tariffs of up to 50% on $20 billion in U.S. goods
item.description: Canadian government officials said they are also providing aid for workers and businesses that could be hurt by U.S.-imposed tariffs.

item.title: Trump threatens to change Lake Ontario's name as trade war with Canada heats up
item.description: President Trump said the U.S. is considering changing the name of Lake Ontario to "Lake America" amid an escalating trade fight with Canada.

item.title: Dolly Parton | 60 Minutes Archive
item.description: "Five feet tall, larger than life." That's how 60 Minutes' Morley Safer described Dolly Parton when he spoke to her in 2009, calling her "the savviest woman in show business." Parton has died at 80, her family announced Tuesday.

item.title: Dolly Parton spent a lifetime giving back: "Inspiring kids to read became my mission"
item.description: Musical icon Dolly Parton's influence on music and pop culture is clear. But beyond that, she was also an entrepreneur and philanthropist. Carter Evans takes a look at Dollywood, her Imagination Library and countless other donations.

item.title: GOP Rep. Tom Barrett "still hopeful" U.S. and Canada can strike trade deal
item.description: The developing U.S.-Canada trade war is set to affect consumers nationwide, but may have an outsized impact on the economies of states along the northern border. Republican Rep. Tom Barrett of Michigan joins "The Takeout" to discuss this and his bill aimed at preventing federal "overreach" on data centers.

item.title: 8/25: CBS Evening News
item.description: Country music legend Dolly Parton died at 80; CIA Director John Ratcliffe took a mysterious trip to Russia.

item.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford says "we just want a fair trade deal" as Canada announces tariffs on U.S.
item.description: Canada announced Tuesday tariffs of up to 50% on $20 billion in U.S. imports to match the Trump administration's recently announced tariffs. Is there an off-ramp for the trade battle? Ontario Premier Doug Ford joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: DOJ warns Kennedy Center could be knocked down if renovations blocked
item.description: The Trump administration said it may need to demolish the Kennedy Center if a plan to close the building for two years as part of a controversial renovation project pushed by President Trump and the organization's board is blocked.

item.title: Judge rejects Ghislaine Maxwell's effort to overturn sex-trafficking conviction
item.description: A federal judge on Tuesday rejected Ghislaine Maxwell's effort to toss out her 2021 conviction on sex-trafficking charges and 20-year prison sentence.
